title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary
description: Ten documented late-hour food destinations in New Orleans, selected as under-21-safe restaurant stops rather than nightlife venues.

cards.title: Melba's Po Boys on Elysian Fields
cards.subtitle: 1525 Elysian Fields Ave, New Orleans, LA 70117
cards.notes: Plan this as an all-hours food option, then check the restaurant’s current notices before setting out for a very late pickup.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour po-boy shop on Elysian Fields Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Melba’s official locations page lists the Elysian Fields restaurant at 1525 Elysian Fields Ave and lists hours of 12:00 AM–12:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 24-hour service daily.

cards.title: Melba's Po Boys on Tulane Avenue
cards.subtitle: 3219 Tulane Ave, New Orleans, LA 70119
cards.notes: Use the separate Tulane Avenue location when its address fits your route; confirm any holiday or weather-related update directly first.
cards.short_summary: Melba’s second New Orleans location is also listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Melba’s official locations page lists Melba's Tulane Ave. at 3219 Tulane Ave and says it opens 24 hours, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Official location page states the Tulane Avenue location opens 24 hours, seven days a week.

cards.title: McDonald's on North Broad
cards.subtitle: 1918 N Broad St, New Orleans, LA 70119
cards.notes: The lobby has earlier hours, so use the official listing to plan for the documented all-night drive-thru service rather than indoor seating.
cards.short_summary: A North Broad McDonald's with a 24-hour drive-thru listing.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official location page lists 1918 N Broad St and shows its drive-thru as open 24 hours daily; the lobby is listed until 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 1918 N Broad St, New Orleans
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is officially listed as open 24 hours daily; lobby hours are 6:00 AM–11:00 PM.

cards.title: IHOP on Canal Street
cards.subtitle: 833 Canal St, New Orleans, LA 70112
cards.notes: Choose this full-service option when you need a sit-down stop after midnight; the official page lists its hours for every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: An IHOP on Canal Street with 24-hour daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official restaurant page for 833 Canal St lists the restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant page lists the location open 24 hours every day.

cards.title: Dat Dog Frenchmen
cards.subtitle: 601 Frenchmen St, New Orleans, LA 70116
cards.notes: For a late meal, use the published Friday–Saturday closing time and verify the day’s schedule before traveling across town.
cards.short_summary: A Frenchmen Street restaurant listed until 3:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Dat Dog’s official locations page lists Dat Dog Frenchmen at 601 Frenchmen St, open until 3:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: U Pizza on Saint Charles

cards.evidence_claim: U Pizza’s official website lists 1513 Saint Charles Ave and business and carryout hours until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: 13 on Frenchmen Street
cards.subtitle: 517 Frenchmen St, New Orleans, LA 70116
cards.notes: Target the listed Friday-through-Sunday late window for food, and consult the restaurant’s own page for any last-minute operating changes.

cards.evidence_claim: 13 on Frenchmen Street’s official menu page lists 517 Frenchmen St and hours until 4:00 AM on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.source_title: 13 on Frenchmen Street — Menu and Hours
